description: A value over time, as a line: the analytical card's first form when the question is "which way is it going". Carries its own scale, grid, legend and a crosshair readout, and reads as a table to a screen reader. Reach for <Sparkline> when the shape sits beside a number and needs no axis, and for <BarChart> when the x axis is categories rather than time. Copy: the accessible label says what the line measures and over what period. Series names are the things themselves, because a legend of "Series 1" is a legend of nothing.

props.name: labels
props.description: The x axis, oldest first: months, weeks, sites.

props.name: series
props.description: One entry per line. Two or more bring a legend with them.

props.name: area
props.description: Fills under the line. For ONE series only: two filled areas overlapping is a chart nobody can read.

props.name: max
props.description: Top of the scale. Defaults to the first nice number above the data.

props.name: target
props.description: A goal drawn across the plot. Its own label is deliberately not a prop: a word printed inside the plot sits on the lines (owner, 23.08). Name the goal in the card's meta line.

props.name: axis
props.description: The scale down the side and the grid with it. On by default.

props.name: label
props.description: What the chart measures. Names it for a screen reader, which reads the table this component renders for it.

props.name: locale
props.description: BCP-47 tag for the numbers. Omit to follow the browser.

example:
<Grid columns={12} gap={4}>
  <GridItem span={8}>
    <Card>
      <Stack gap={3}>
        <SectionLabel as="h3">Raised against closed</SectionLabel>
        <LineChart
          labels={MONTHS}
          series={[
            { label: 'Raised', values: [52, 61, 48, 67, 72] },
            { label: 'Closed', values: [34, 41, 28, 47, 52] },
          ]}
          target={60}
          label="Findings raised and closed per month"
        />
      </Stack>
    </Card>
  </GridItem>
  <GridItem span={4}>
    <Card>
      <Stack gap={3}>
        <SectionLabel as="h3">Sessions</SectionLabel>
        
        <LineChart
          labels={MONTHS}
          series={[{ label: 'Sessions', values: [180, 176, 191, 203, 221] }]}
          area
          size="sm"
          label="Sessions per month"
        />
      </Stack>
    </Card>
  </GridItem>
</Grid>
